assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create a print-ready flat two-page magazine art composition, landscape ratio 22:17, for an imagined 1977 Tenerife futures conference. NOT a mockup of a book, no gutter shadow, no border, no typography anywhere. This is an ambitious French contributor's hand-cut photomontage imagining 'dreaming together': volcanic coastal self-built white houses grow into a communal organism, terraces, washing, stairs, swimmers and gorgonian sea fans mingle. Black-and-white coarse halftone photographic cutouts over saturated ultramarine and ochre flat ink areas, with fine hand-inked meandering connections. Analogue scissors-and-glue uneven photographic edges, 1960s radical architectural little magazine energy, visually dense but precise. Tenerife's dark cliff and Teide in distance; temperate Atlantic, NO tropical coral reef. Composition crucial: collage forms a richly detailed continuous band across the middle 50% of BOTH pages; top 25% on LEFT half clean warm ivory space for a real headline later; lower 25% of BOTH halves clean pale ivory for text later. On RIGHT upper quarter an enormous cut-out sun and small seed-like houses, asymmetrical. No generated letters, no wireframe, no digital gradient, no 3D render, no pastel infographic. This is artwork to actually span two facing digest pages. High resolution.

Use case: illustration-story. A flat two-page 1977 little-magazine composition, landscape 22:17. Pen and scratchy wood-engraving black ink with one small vermilion accent, on clean warm ivory. Subject: the young film workshop's affectionate doubt about futurists: an impossibly over-elaborate municipal tower on Tenerife, made of filing drawers, balconies, stairs that go nowhere, big cog wheels, laundry, window boxes, humble kitchens, registration counters and curtains. Two tiny dreamers at a lower window are trying to hoist a fragile paper glider while vegetation and seabirds happily exceed the plan. Rich, funny, slightly grotesque, humane, dense tiny visual stories; historical engraved book illustration meeting 1970s radical paper collage. The absurd structure occupies the RIGHT two-thirds with branches reaching far into LEFT half across the imaginary centre. On LEFT top, an empty ivory rectangular area about 35% width and 30% height for a later typeset headline; lower LEFT quarter left empty for real text later. At lower RIGHT the detailed structure dissolves into dark volcanic crags and a small sea. Not a cartoon of a famous person, no identifiable characters, no text, no signatures, no wireframe, no polished vector, no digital render, no actual page crease, no mockup. Reproduce as original artwork for the fictional film desk, not as a historical recovered document. High resolution black ink drawing.

Use case: historical-scene. Vertical archival-style botanical field photograph, 2:3 portrait. El Drago, the enormous Dracaena draco tree at Icod de los Vinos on Tenerife: stout many-trunked tree, dense rounded branching crown of sword leaves, genuinely dragon tree silhouette not umbrella pine. A low stone wall and two small unidentifiable 1970s visitors with a notebook give scale. Shot from below on grainy 35mm black-and-white film, overcast sky, photographic dark foliage and pale bark, extremely tactile coarse newspaper halftone, slightly imperfect exposure. Deep charcoal and ivory only, no sepia wash. Entire tree visible, sky to upper left and crown in upper right, roots and volcanic stone at bottom. Flat printable image, no border, no captions, no typography, no watermarks, no artificial scratches. A new imagined excursion photograph for a fictional 1977 magazine, not documentation of an actual historical event.
